余料建造 / 融合系统：按 Y 键可将素材与武器融合，最终攻击力 = 武器基础攻击 + 素材加成。龙骨碎片 / 银色莱乃尔角最高可加 +55；宝石融合附加元素属性（🔥火 / ❄冰 / ⚡雷）。大师之剑耐久无限，耗尽后约 10 分钟充能，不会永久破损。

Fuse system: press Y to fuse a material to a weapon, and final attack = weapon base attack + material bonus. Dragon Bone Fragments / Silver Lynel horns add up to +55 at most. Fusing gems adds elemental properties (🔥 Fire / ❄ Ice / ⚡ Lightning). The Master Sword has infinite durability, recharging in about 10 minutes after depletion, and never breaks permanently.
